Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You catch the rhythm of your companions’ steps and give them the next beat.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Two willing allies within 3 squares who hear you.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Each moves 1 square toward a visible enemy without provoking, one at a time. Their actions remain their own.
